description: Negative test cases for Storage Policy binary contract. All fixtures test protocol-level validation rules.

negative_cases.name: storage_policy_value_zero
negative_cases.description: Storage Policy value = 0 (invalid, must be in range 1..4)

negative_cases.name: storage_policy_value_five
negative_cases.description: Storage Policy value = 5 (invalid, outside known range 1..4)

negative_cases.name: malformed_fid
negative_cases.description: REC_STORAGE_POLICY record with wrong Field ID (0x0902 instead of 0x0901)

negative_cases.name: truncated_field
negative_cases.description: Field length claims 2 bytes but only 1 byte of value present
negative_cases.rule: Field value must contain declared number of bytes

negative_cases.name: truncated_record
negative_cases.description: Record length claims 5 bytes payload but only 3 bytes present
negative_cases.rule: Record payload must contain declared number of bytes

negative_cases.name: duplicate_storage_policy
negative_cases.rule: Exactly one StoragePolicy record per container

negative_cases.name: missing_storage_policy
negative_cases.description: Canonical writer container without any REC_STORAGE_POLICY record
negative_cases.rule: Canonical containers MUST include StoragePolicy record

negative_cases.name: obsolete_mode_declaration
negative_cases.description: Container with only obsolete REC_MODE_DECLARATION (0x0007), no StoragePolicy
negative_cases.rule: ModeDeclaration is obsolete; canonical writers MUST emit StoragePolicy instead

negative_cases.name: malformed_record_length
negative_cases.description: Storage Policy record with non-minimal uvarint length encoding
negative_cases.rule: Length must use minimal uvarint encoding (GR-24)
